name: Vegan Homemade Ravioli with Meatballs and Parmesan
description: A comforting, fully plant-based Italian feast featuring tender homemade vegan ravioli stuffed with dairy-free ricotta and spinach. Served alongside hearty lentil meatballs, rich marinara sauce, and topped with a savory cashew parmesan.

wet.name: Prepared flax egg
wet.notes: 1 tbsp ground flaxseed mixed with 3 tbsp water, rested for 5 mins

dry.name: Nutritional yeast
dry.notes: Divided (4 tbsp for filling, 2 tbsp for parmesan)

dry.name: Garlic powder
dry.notes: Divided (1 tsp for meatballs, 0.25 tsp for parmesan)

instructions.description: Make the vegan parmesan: In a small food processor, pulse the raw cashews, 2 tablespoons of nutritional yeast, 0.5 teaspoon of salt, and 0.25 teaspoon of garlic powder until it resembles a fine, grated parmesan texture. Set aside.

Make the meatball mixture: In a food processor, combine the cooked lentils, breadcrumbs, fresh parsley, flax egg, 1 teaspoon of garlic powder, and 1 teaspoon of onion powder. Pulse until the mixture holds together when pressed, but retains some texture. Form into 1-inch balls.
Bake the meatballs: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Place the formed meatballs on a parchment-lined baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden and firm. Set aside.

Prepare the pasta dough: In a large bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour and 0.5 teaspoon of salt. Create a well in the center and pour in the warm water and olive oil. Mix until a dough forms, then knead on a floured surface for 5-8 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover with a damp towel and let rest for 30 minutes.
Prepare the ravioli filling: In a medium bowl, mix the vegan ricotta, chopped spinach, 4 tablespoons of nutritional yeast, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Stir until well combined.

Assemble the ravioli: Divide the rested dough in half. Roll each half out on a floured surface until very thin (about 1/16 inch thick). Place 1-tablespoon dollops of the ricotta filling about 2 inches apart on one dough sheet. Lightly brush water around each dollop, carefully place the second sheet of dough on top, press down around the filling to remove air bubbles and seal, then cut into squares using a knife or ravioli cutter.

Cook the ravioli: Bring a large pot of salted water to a gentle boil. Carefully drop the ravioli into the water in batches. Cook for 3-4 minutes, or until they float to the surface. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain.
Serve: Warm the marinara sauce in a large skillet. Add the baked lentil meatballs and gently fold in the cooked ravioli. Divide among plates and top generously with the homemade cashew parmesan.

notes: For an even richer ravioli filling, add a pinch of nutmeg and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice to the vegan ricotta mixture. If you have a pasta machine, you can roll the dough to setting 6 or 7 for perfectly even, thin sheets.
